content.comment_body: Has anyone tried the [product_name] App, and is it actually useful? Can it serve as a replacement for a physical display? How easy is it to use, and is the overall experience good? Open to feedback from anyone who has used it.

If you're looking to replace a display, consider using teslascada software. It allows you to set alerts, receive notifications, and view trend charts via Telegram, integrating data from multiple [product_name] modules simultaneously. Although it's not completely free, the pricing is reasonable and you can test it before purchasing. I recently worked on a project with a KTP700 and found the usual engineering software challenging, but now I've managed to show all my data on a large TV at lower cost and with more convenience. The system also works on mobile devices and I'd rate it 9 out of 10.
